scripts.dev: npm run build -w @create-for-christ/contracts && concurrently --kill-others -n api,mobile "npm run dev -w @create-for-christ/api" "npm run start -w @create-for-christ/mobile"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @create-for-christ/contracts && npm run dev -w @create-for-christ/api
scripts.dev:mobile: npm run build -w @create-for-christ/contracts && npm run start -w @create-for-christ/mobile
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @create-for-christ/contracts && npm run web -w @create-for-christ/mobile
scripts.build: npm run build -w @create-for-christ/contracts && npm run build -w @create-for-christ/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @create-for-christ/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @create-for-christ/contracts && npm run test -w @create-for-christ/api
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w @create-for-christ/contracts && npm run test:integration -w @create-for-christ/api
